causes: Skipping the intro can leave PLAYER disabled on the inactive list. basketball_init previously activated only actors 1..6, while stock actors_render starts at PLAYER.prev. place() wrote ACTIVE without repairing linked lists.
The browser emulator painted the court over sprites while CGB background priority was enabled.
fixes: Pin and clear DISABLED on all seven basketball actors, activating PLAYER first through the engine API.
Set CGB foreground object priority when starting a lineup; restore background priority for lineup menus and results.
checkedRoutesNote: PyBoy route recordings cover the intermediate actor activation repair. Final ROM was additionally replayed in official Binjgb and played through the built-in browser.

binjgb.result: Players and ball visible in final native ROM; capture precedes diagnostic memory writes.

browser.result: Players and ball visible after lineup confirmation; browser paused for handoff.

previewLimitation: Existing preview listener serves the refreshed official web export, but plugin preview-close acknowledgement remains UNKNOWN and saved progress is unavailable. Original broken state retained; no save-state deletion or plugin internals changed.
